proposed_comments.title: Show the Stop Sharing shortcut in its tooltip (1/3)
proposed_comments.body:
### Show the Stop Sharing shortcut in its tooltip (1/3)

**Severity:** `medium`

The Stop Sharing entry currently receives the Share Window shortcut: its action reaches the title, icon and command, but not this tooltip call. With the default shortcuts this advertises Win+Ctrl+Shift+W instead of Win+Ctrl+Shift+Q. Forward the action here, accept it in the helper, and select PresenterStopShortcut for StopSharing. Apply all three parts together; the command itself already dispatches the correct stop event.

```suggestion
                Description = GetModuleToolTip(moduleType, action),
```

proposed_comments.body:
### Show the Stop Sharing shortcut in its tooltip (2/3)

**Severity:** `medium`

Accept the action forwarded in part 1 so the helper can distinguish Share Window from Stop Sharing. Keeping the parameter optional preserves the existing one-argument behavior for other callers. Apply with parts 1 and 3.

```suggestion
        private string GetModuleToolTip(ModuleType moduleType, string? action = null)
```

proposed_comments.title: Show the Stop Sharing shortcut in its tooltip (3/3)
proposed_comments.body:
### Show the Stop Sharing shortcut in its tooltip (3/3)

**Severity:** `medium`

Use PresenterStopShortcut for StopSharing while keeping PresenterActivationShortcut for Share Window. Both defaults and customized shortcuts then come from the setting corresponding to the action. Apply with parts 1 and 2. Focused verification: use distinct share/stop shortcuts and check each tooltip; repeat after customizing them.

```suggestion
                ModuleType.LaserPointer => action == LaserPointerActions.StopSharing
                    ? SettingsRepository<LaserPointerSettings>.GetInstance(SettingsUtils.Default).SettingsConfig.Properties.PresenterStopShortcut.ToString()
                    : SettingsRepository<LaserPointerSettings>.GetInstance(SettingsUtils.Default).SettingsConfig.Properties.PresenterActivationShortcut.ToString(),
```
